name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-builder
description: Self-contained Electron desktop packaging for DeepSeek Harness on macOS
author: DeepSeek AI

scripts.dist:dev: npm run test && npm run verify:source-privacy && npm run prepare:icon && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:profile && npm run verify:profile-runtime && DSH_DESKTOP_CHANNEL=dev npm run prepare:release && DSH_DESKTOP_CHANNEL=dev electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 && DSH_DESKTOP_CHANNEL=dev npm run verify:release-privacy
